## What this letter says
You had a blood test on 16 September 2026. It is called an HbA1c test.
Your result was 58 mmol/mol.
You should keep taking your medicine, metformin, for now.
The nurse team will talk about raising your dose at your review. No increase has been decided yet.

## What you need to do
1. Keep taking metformin 500 milligrams, twice a day, for now.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: your HbA1c blood test. The result was 58 mmol/mol.
- 9 November 2026: your review appointment. The nurse team will talk about the metformin dose.
- Metformin: 500 milligrams, twice a day. Keep taking it for now.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does my HbA1c result of 58 mmol/mol mean for me?
- What will we talk about at my review on 9 November 2026?
- How will we decide about my metformin dose?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
